mapper.select: SELECT a.program_id , a.system_service_id , a.role_code , c.role_name FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_ACCESS_N a , LGCOM_PROGRAM_M b , LGCOM_ROLE_M c WHERE a.program_id = #{programId} AND a.system_service_id = #{systemServiceId} AND a.program_id = b.program_id AND a.role_code = c.role_code(+) ORDER BY a.program_id, a.system_service_id, c.role_name
